title: f82r.14 reference, verification, and return clause
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. The already exposed f82r.14 line is provisionally a compact reference/check construction: an active record identifies a target, applies an operation to an item, checks it against a second operand, and returns to the active record.

target.raw: r olchy qokal chey qokain deeedy qokeey qokaiin olchedy
target.ownership: Existing exposed W80 report-owned complete local line; no new target access.

design.rule: r opens the active record; olchy identifies its target field; qokal/chey apply an operation to qokain; deeedy-qokeey form the check/result pair; qokaiin supplies a second typed operand; olchedy returns/ closes the active record. No container or convergence meaning is imported.
design.worked_content: An active record identifies a target field, applies an operation to one item, checks the resulting item against a second operand, and records the verification back on the original record.
design.rival: Two-route convergence models IDEA000408/410 predict independently described paths sharing one downstream result; this model predicts one active record with a verification edge.
design.consequence: A later complete line with the same deeedy-qokeey check and one changed operand should change the comparison while preserving the record endpoint. No semantic held observation currently tests this.
design.limits: All operator and operand identities are hypothetical; qokain/qokaiin are not given old scalar, air, water or container glosses. The line alone cannot establish reference direction or return scope.
design.access: Existing exposed excerpt and predecessor reports only; no new target access, images, reserves, decoder, route, ledger or publication.
